title: Neuro Rehabilitation Support Worker
description:
Neuro Rehabilitation Support Worker

Location: Rotherham

Salary: £13.45 per hour

Contract Type: Bank (occasional), Part-Time and Full-Time Opportunities Available

Join a Team Where You Can Truly Make a Difference

At Ariya Neuro Care, we believe that rehabilitation is about more than recovery. It's about helping people rediscover confidence, independence, purpose, and hope following a life-changing brain injury.

We're looking for kind, positive, and enthusiastic people to join our outstanding team in Rotherham. Whether you're experienced in care, looking for a complete career change, or seeking valuable experience within a therapeutic environment, we'd love to hear from you.

If you're someone who enjoys helping others, values teamwork, and wants a role where every day brings something new, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

About the Role

As a Neuro Rehabilitation Support Worker, you'll play an important part in supporting individuals as they work towards their rehabilitation goals and rebuild their lives following an acquired brain injury.

Working closely with our specialist neurotherapy team, you'll help people develop skills, gain confidence, and achieve greater independence in a warm and supportive environment.

The role includes:
- Supporting rehabilitation programmes and individual goals
- Encouraging independence and confidence
- Assisting with daily living activities and routines
- Working collaboratively with therapists and colleagues
- Supporting social, leisure, and community activities
- Providing personal care when required
- Helping create a positive and encouraging environment where people can thrive

Who We're Looking For

We welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and life experiences. Most importantly, we're looking for individuals who share our values and genuinely enjoy helping others succeed.

You may be a great fit if you are:
- Kind, caring, and compassionate
- Positive, enthusiastic, and encouraging
- A team player who enjoys working collaboratively
- Adaptable and enjoys variety in your work
- Interested in rehabilitation and helping people achieve their goals
- Eager to learn and develop new skills
- Practical, proactive, and supportive in your approach

Previous care experience is not essential, as we provide comprehensive training, mentoring, and ongoing support. What matters most is your attitude, commitment, and desire to make a positive impact.

Why Join Ariya Neuro Care?

We are incredibly proud of the environment we've created for both the people we support and the colleagues who work with us.

Our services have achieved the rare distinction of being rated 'Outstanding' across all areas by CQC, reflecting the exceptional outcomes achieved through our compassionate and person-centred approach.

We have also been awarded the prestigious Platinum Investors in People Accreditation, recognising our commitment to supporting, developing, and valuing our staff.

When you join our team, you'll benefit from:
- Full induction and specialist training
- Ongoing mentoring and professional support
- Opportunities for career progression
- Leadership and management development programmes
- The chance to work alongside highly skilled neurotherapy professionals
- A genuinely supportive, friendly, and collaborative team culture

Working Pattern

This role operates on a rota basis and includes:
- Day, evening, and weekend shifts
- All aspects of personal care
- Opportunities for bank, part-time, and full-time working

Benefits
- Employee mentoring programme
- Free flu vaccinations
- Free parking
- Health and wellbeing programme
- On-site parking
- Employee discount scheme
- Referral programme

To Apply

If you feel you are a suitable candidate and would like to work for Ariya Neuro Care, please do not hesitate to apply.

title: Home Care Assistant
company: Elite Search Associates Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Home Care Assistant Rotherham

£13.65 per hour Full-time and part-time opportunities Minimum 20 hours per week

30p per mile for drivers No previous experience required

Are you caring, compassionate and passionate about making a positive difference in people s lives? We re looking for dedicated Home Care Assistants to join our team at our Rotherham branch, supporting individuals to live safely, comfortably and independently in their own homes.

You don t need previous care experience to apply. We re looking for people with the right values, a kind and patient approach, and a genuine desire to help others. We ll provide a comprehensive induction, full training and ongoing support to help you develop the skills and confidence needed to succeed in your role.

The role

As a Home Care Assistant, you ll provide person-centred care and support to individuals in their own homes, helping them maintain their independence, dignity and quality of life.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Providing personal care, including assistance with washing, dressing and toileting.
- Preparing meals and supporting individuals with their daily routines.
- Assisting with medication in line with training and individual care plans.
- Helping with everyday household tasks.
- Offering companionship, reassurance and emotional support.
- Treating every individual with dignity, kindness and respect.

Hours and shift patterns

We offer both full-time and part-time opportunities, with a minimum commitment of 20 hours per week.

Shifts are available across the following times:
- Morning/day shifts: 6am 2pm.
- Afternoon/evening shifts: 3pm 10pm.

You ll work on a two-week rolling rota, covering four days one week and three days the following week.

Weekend availability is essential. You can choose from the following weekend patterns:
- Working both Saturday and Sunday every other weekend; or
- Working every Saturday or every Sunday.

What we re looking for

We re keen to hear from people who are:
- Compassionate, patient and reliable.
- Committed to promoting dignity, respect and independence.
- Good communicators who enjoy supporting others.
- Willing to learn and develop new skills.
- Aged 18 or over.

Drivers are preferred, with mileage paid at 30p per mile. However, non-drivers are also welcome to apply if they can travel locally between care visits within the Rotherham area.

What we offer
- £13.65 per hour.
- 30p per mile for drivers.
- Full induction and comprehensive training.
- Ongoing training and opportunities for career development.
- Continued support to help you grow in your role.
- The opportunity to make a genuine difference in your local community.

Make a difference with us

If you have a caring nature, the right attitude and a desire to help others live independently, we d love to hear from you.

Apply today to join our Rotherham team and start a rewarding career in home care. No previous experience is necessary just the right values and a willingness to learn.

title: Outreach Rehabilitation Support Worker
description:
Outreach Rehabilitation Support Worker

Location: South and West Yorkshire

Salary: £13.45 per hour

Contract Type: Full-Time, Part-Time Opportunities Available

At Ariya Neuro Care, we are passionate about helping people rebuild their confidence, independence, and quality of life following a life-changing injury. As our Outreach Team continues to grow, we are looking for warm, proactive, and enthusiastic individuals to join us in making a real difference every day.

If you're looking for a rewarding role where no two days are the same, and where you'll be supported to learn, grow, and positively impact the lives of others, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

As an Outreach Rehabilitation Support Worker, you'll support individuals in their own homes, workplaces, and local communities, helping them work towards their rehabilitation goals and live as independently as possible.

One day you might be supporting someone to attend university, and the next you could be helping them enjoy activities such as:
- Swimming
- Bowling
- Woodturning
- Boccia
- Community groups and social activities
- Education and employment opportunities

Alongside rehabilitation-focused activities, you'll also support people with daily living tasks, including:
- Cooking and meal preparation
- Household tasks and organisation
- Morning and evening routines
- Personal care and wellbeing support

Every individual is different, making each day rewarding, engaging, and full of opportunities to make a genuine difference.

Who We're Looking For

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. Previous care experience is not essential, as we provide full training and ongoing support.

We're looking for people who are:
- Kind, compassionate, and respectful
- Positive and encouraging
- Reliable and motivated
- Eager to learn and develop new skills
- Passionate about helping others achieve their goals
- Comfortable working independently while being part of a supportive team

Most importantly, we're looking for individuals who genuinely want to help others thrive.

Why Join Ariya Neuro Care?

Our services are rated Outstanding by CQC, and we have also achieved the prestigious Platinum Investors in People accreditation. These achievements reflect the supportive culture we've created and our commitment to both the people we support and the colleagues who work with us.

When you join Ariya Neuro Care, you can expect:
- Comprehensive induction and full training
- Ongoing mentoring and support
- Opportunities to work alongside specialist neurotherapy professionals
- Excellent career progression pathways
- Management and leadership development programmes
- A collaborative, friendly, and positive working environment

For those looking to explore careers in health, rehabilitation, psychology, occupational therapy, speech and language therapy, physiotherapy, or social care, this role offers fantastic hands-on experience.

Flexible Opportunities

This role can also be combined with shifts within our residential rehabilitation service, allowing you to gain valuable experience across both community and residential settings if desired.

Essential Requirements

As this role is primarily community-based, applicants must:
- Hold a full UK Driving Licence
- Have access to a vehicle

Working Pattern

This role operates on a flexible rota and includes:
- Day shifts
- Night shifts
- Weekend working

Benefits
- Employee discount scheme
- Free flu vaccinations
- Health and wellbeing programme
- On-site parking
- Ongoing training and career development opportunities

To Apply

If you feel you are a suitable candidate and would like to work for Ariya Neuro Care, please do not hesitate to apply.

title: Night Support worker
description:
Location: South Yorkshire
Contract: Casual / Ad-Hoc Shifts

Ashberry Recruitment are currently recruiting experienced Night Support Workers to work on an ad-hoc basis across supported accommodation services in South Yorkshire.

The services support vulnerable individuals, including people experiencing homelessness, rough sleeping, substance misuse and complex personal circumstances. The role will involve providing overnight support, maintaining a safe and secure environment, and responding appropriately to the needs of residents.

This is an excellent opportunity for experienced support workers looking for flexible, ad-hoc night shifts within homelessness and supported accommodation settings.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide overnight support to vulnerable adults living in supported accommodation.
- Support individuals experiencing homelessness, rough sleeping and substance misuse.
- Maintain a safe, secure and welcoming environment throughout night shifts.
- Carry out regular building checks and monitor the wellbeing of residents.
- Respond appropriately to incidents, emergencies and challenging behaviour.
- Provide reassurance and practical support to residents when required.
- Complete accurate handovers, incident reports and relevant documentation.
- Follow safeguarding procedures, health and safety policies and risk assessments.
- Work independently during night shifts while following service procedures.

Essential Requirements
- An Enhanced Child + Adult DBS which is registered on the update service.
- Previous experience working with homeless individuals and rough sleepers.
- Experience supporting people affected by substance misuse and addiction.
- Previous experience within supported accommodation, hostels, homeless shelters or similar residential settings.
- Good understanding of safeguarding, professional boundaries and risk management.
- Ability to manage challenging situations calmly and professionally.
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently overnight.
- Flexibility and availability to cover ad-hoc night shifts.
